repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-scheduler
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin scaffold registered as webex.internal.scheduler. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-encryption and registers the Scheduler plugin with a placeholder config under the scheduler key and three example payload predicates and transforms; webex-core tests the predicates in each webex.transform call of webex instances built after the import. Scheduler has no scheduling behavior; its methods (exampleRequestUsage, exampleEventUsage, exampleMercuryConnection) are examples.

scheduler-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-encryption for its side effect and registers Scheduler as the internal plugin 'scheduler' with config {scheduler: {...five placeholder keys}} and three example payload predicates and transforms. The barrel src/index.js exports only Scheduler as default. Behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Host contract consumed by Scheduler: WebexPlugin supplies this.webex, this.logger, this.config, the ampersand event methods, and request(), which delegates to webex.request; registerInternalPlugin installs the plugin, merges its config, and appends its payload predicates and transforms, which webex.transform evaluates.

encryption-sdk.summary: Imported for its registration side effect in src/index.js; the encryption plugin's own imports register the device and Mercury plugins. The example transforms call webex.internal.encryption.example, which the encryption plugin does not define.

mercury-sdk.summary: exampleMercuryConnection calls webex.internal.mercury.connect() with no arguments and briefly listens for event:scope. Declared in package.json but not imported by src/; registered through the internal-plugin-encryption import. Owned and specified by @webex/internal-plugin-mercury.
